description: The material contained in these last two binders, concerning Pueblo Sexual Symbolism and Linguistics, were found in five black clamp binders with any sort of title or label. The material is presented in the order in which it was found in each black binder. There was no indication of the sequence of the binders themselves. In these black clamp binders were photographs, drawings, and notes pertaining to Pueblo Sexual Symbolism. In Binder V there is one page of letter from Ann Marriott to Chabot, Feb 19 or 20, 1958, [sheet 9]. In Binder VI there is a typed note from Marjorie Lambert to Chabot, Jan. 30, 1958, [sheet 40].
title: Photographs, drawings, notes, correspondence
